description: BOSTON, MA — IBEW Local 103, representing more than 7,000 electrical workers across the Greater Boston area, announced its endorsement of Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell for re-election, citing her extraordinary record fighting for workers, holding corporations accountable, and delivering real results for working families across Massachusetts.

title: IBEW Local 103 Endorses Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell for Re-Election - Andrea Joy Campbell for Attorney General
